description: Separate a tap from a drag on a surface that accepts both, and choose whether the movement threshold also gates the surface's motion. Use when building or reviewing a control that is draggable *and* has per-item click targets — a wheel or drum picker, a carousel, a slider track, a reorderable list, a map, a canvas, a crop frame, a colour field — or when a tap on such a surface does nothing, a click fires at the end of a drag, a drag that returns to where it started is mistaken for a click, the surface jumps a few pixels as a drag begins, or the cursor turns into a grabbing hand before any drag has happened.
